name: bb-plugin-spot-chat
description: Ask a quick question in a fresh BB chat without leaving your current thread. It opens as a panel inside BB that the same button or shortcut closes, or as a separate window (macOS only). It uses the model BB would pick for a new chat unless you choose one for Spot Chat.
author: FeelsGoodEtc
